name: Burton Upon Trent Foodbank
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Burton Family Centre. Open Tue and Thu for distribution. Referral required via local agencies and schools.

name: East Staffs Borough Allotments
short_description: Allotment sites managed by East Staffordshire Council
description: East Staffordshire Council manages sites across Burton including All Saints Road
image: and Wetmore Road. Plots from £25/year. Waiting lists operate. Includes water and storage facilities.

name: Burton Community Garden
description: Volunteer-run garden behind Stapenhill Cemetery. Grows vegetables and soft fruits for sharing. Surplus produce available to local residents during summer. Open Sundays 10am-3pm.
